pools.pin_c: eval/vocr4_pools_c.sha256 (tt, rd, rp2 and the exclusion list), committed with this protocol

C.what: the control: VOCR3's realplus fine-tune (eval/vocr3_rp_run.sh) on VOCR4's cleaned pools, from the reused pretrain
C.fine_tune: nv 0.25 + synth2 0.125 + synth3 v2 0.125 + tt 0.2 + rd 0.1 + rp2 (ink + GRAD) 0.2

A.what: the new real pools: C with the real half re-split, from the same reused pretrain
A.fine_tune: nv 0.25 + synth2 0.125 + synth3 v2 0.125 + tt 0.175 + rd 0.1 + rp3i (ink + GRAD) 0.175 + nat (ink + GRAD) 0.025 + own (ink + GRAD) 0.025

M.what: synth3 v3 in place of synth3 v2: a new pretrain from scratch, then A's fine-tune
M.pretrain: pre_<SIZE>_M3_seed<S>: nv 0.5 + synth2 0.25 + synth3 v3 0.25; the size's pretrain steps (FL10 128,000, H15 40,000, W20 32,000); batch 96, lr 2e-3, warmup 1,000, cosine to 0.05, wd 0.01, EMA 0.999 (VOCR3's pretrain recipe)
M.fine_tune: nv 0.25 + synth2 0.125 + synth3 v3 0.125 + A's real sources and weights

arms.recipe: every fine-tune: 15,000 steps, batch 96, lr 1.2e-3, warmup 500, cosine to 0.05, wd 0.01, EMA 0.999, kd 0, real sources inv=0.5, synthetic stream=1,pool=3,inv=0.2 (VOCR3's); the size's topology and vocab; --seed S (C and A from the one reused pretrain, so their seeds vary the fine-tune only; M's seed also seeds its pretrain); the final EMA checkpoint (ckpt_step15000.pt) is the run; train2's in-run evaluations (the amendment-8 teacher_val, logged) select nothing
arms.script: eval/vocr4_run.sh SIZE ARM SEED through HEAVY_SLOTS=10 $HERD/heavy.sh (5 threads); outputs $HERD/shared/artifacts/vocr4-train/runs/<run>/
arms.order: M pretrains first (they need no pool): FL10 seeds 1 and 2, then H15, then W20; C fine-tunes as slots allow (FL10 first); A fine-tunes as soon as pin_a is committed (FL10 first); M fine-tunes after their pretrains and pin_a. At most 8 VOCR4 training runs at once on the shared box, fewer if synth4-design asks for slots
arms.failures: a run that dies is deleted and restarted from scratch with the same arguments (runs never resume; train2's resume reseeds the batch stream); every restart is reported

teacher_val.note: VOCR3's amendment-8 copy (no Memories Off series); the planetarian rule removes nothing (eval/vocr4_planetarian_check_20261013.json), so it is also the planetarian-free version

score: eval/synth3_ablation.py score (the C runtime W8I, views rv and rvn) on teacher_val and on devnative's four files; a run's development score is the mean of its teacher_val CER (both views) and its devnative CER (the four files pooled, both views)

decisions.real: per size, C -> A over the seed pairs (v4c_<SIZE>_seedS, v4a_<SIZE>_seedS), S = 1, 2: eval/vocr4_select.py decide --decision real. A is adopted iff the stratified VN-cluster 95% interval (10,000 resamples; teacher_val's and devnative's VNs resampled independently, seeds 0 and 1) of the development-score difference lies entirely below 0, both pairs' development-score differences are below 0, and neither cohort's own interval lies entirely above 0
decisions.synth: per size, X -> M over the seed pairs, X being the real decision's adopted arm (A, or C when A is not adopted): eval/vocr4_select.py decide --decision synth, the same rule
decisions.order: a size's real decision is computed once all four of its C and A runs are scored; its synth decision once its M runs are scored too; each decision file is committed before that size's selection

selection.rule: per size, the candidates are the two runs of the arm the decisions end on (M if the synth decision adopts it, otherwise the real decision's arm); the lowest development score wins; ties at 5 decimals go to the lower seed; a blob outside the budget is not selectable (eval/vocr4_select.py select)
selection.reported: every run of the size is scored and listed; only candidates can be selected
selection.commit: each size's selection (every run's scores, the decisions, the selected run and blob sha256) is committed and pushed before the locked report runs

locked_report.when: once, after the three selections are committed
locked_report.tool: eval/vocr3_report.py (shared, a9, overlay, render) with the spec from eval/vocr4_make_spec.py; the commit is recorded

sets.vita-test, psp-test fixed lines: eval/run.py's recognizer mode through the scalar C W8I runtime; console polarity primary, native also; per set, per style, per VN, pooled; full text and hiragana
sets.vita-test, psp-test whole dialogue: each region at base and +4 / +8 native px with the arm's own C finder (VOCR2's held-out guard scoring)
sets.planetarian: the old and the new manifests are identical (no planetarian line in either set), so the report's numbers are both; docs/vocr4.md shows the two columns with that note

If the references are frozen only after the rest of the report, this part runs once then, as an addendum; nothing can change a selection. the overlay host cross-check (vita-jp-overlay tools/benchmark_local_ocr.py on a read-only clone)

qualification.fixed_line_gate: VOCR2's: in the primary polarity, no set's full-text or hiragana errors increase, and pooled hiragana errors decrease
qualification.dialogue_guard: VOCR2's held-out whole-dialogue guard: no title/variant all-text or body full/hiragana regression; every variant improves console-balanced hiragana in both scopes and gains on at least two titles
qualification.consequence: a candidate qualifies to replace a released default only if every gate passes; even then the default changes only with the owner's agreement. The blobs go on a pre-release whatever the result
